title: 第87章 林业站的站长来买王八
content_zh:
第87章 林业站的站长来买王八-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

九分钱一斤！

这性价比可是高的出奇，毕竟现在红薯都要八分钱一斤，玉米面都要一毛了，大米更是要一毛三，一毛四，听说最近又开始涨价了。

当然了，最重要的。

买十斤送一斤，大家虽然不会算账，但这九分钱一斤的鱼，差不多也算是八分钱一斤吗？

具体划下来多少钱一斤，这些土乡的村民还真算不出来。

反正，很便宜就是了。

平日里都吃红薯干，今天也想开开荤不是。

至于那一毛二的。

贵也有贵的道理，稀少，好吃，都是蒜瓣肉，刺少……！

"这草鱼不错，估计的有十来斤吧，给我来条这个，回家大酱焖一下，肯定好吃。"

“给我来几条鲤鱼，我回家炖豆腐去。”

“这青鱼不错啊，也给我来几条，不能少秤吧？”

“小伙子，怎么抓的，这么多？”

“明天还有不，今天没带多少钱啊。”

周围村民纷纷挑选自己看中的鱼，然后拿给李青山去称重道。

“明天早晨，还是这个点，肯定还来的，还是今天这个价格，我们抓这些鱼，可是废了老鼻子劲了，抓鱼的可不止我们几个，我们几个只是过来卖鱼的。”

“大娘，你家儿媳妇刚生了孩子啊，那来一条鲫鱼吧，鲫鱼炖豆腐，熬出奶白奶白的汤，肯定大补，还有这黑鱼棒子，下奶的，也炖豆腐，好吃还营养，奶水营养也足，孙子吃了肯定能长得白白胖胖的。”

“大爷牙口不好啊，嗨……鱼肉又不是猪肉，三岁小孩都能嚼烂，最合适不过了。”

“大叔，你看啊，高高的秤，一点不带低的。”

李青山一边说着，一边开始秤鱼，五百多斤的鱼很快就差不多卖光了，还剩下两条黄鳝没啥人买。

这东西主要是贵，一毛二一斤，而且这地方吃的人不多，不太会吃，但是这东西可是男人的大补之物，也叫男人的水中嗷嗷叫。

这个年代的黄鳝，可比后世的黄鳝大多了。

后世的黄鳝，不少筷子粗细就被抓上来了，大一些的也不过大拇指粗细，但李青山今天抓到的这两条，足足有婴儿手臂粗细，都三斤左右了，跟个小鳗鱼一样。

Nine cents a pound!

This price-performance ratio is surprisingly high. After all, sweet potatoes now cost eight cents a pound, cornmeal costs ten cents, and rice costs one cent three cents or one cent four cents. I heard that prices have started to rise again recently.

Of course, the most important thing.

Buy ten pounds and get one pound free. Although everyone doesn’t know how to settle accounts, does the fish costing nine cents per catty count as eight cents per catty?

The villagers in these rural areas really can't figure out how much it costs per pound.

Anyway, it's very cheap.

I usually eat dried sweet potatoes, but today I wanted to try some meat.

As for the 12 cents.

It's expensive for a reason, it's rare, it's delicious, it's all garlic clove meat, it has few thorns...!

"This grass carp is pretty good. I think it weighs about ten kilograms. Give me one of these. I can stew it with soybean paste at home. It will definitely be delicious."

"Bring me some carp, and I'll go home and make tofu stew."

"This herring is pretty good. Give me a few too. Can't we weigh them less?"

"Young man, how did you catch so many?"

"Is there any tomorrow? I didn't bring much money today."

The surrounding villagers picked out the fish they liked, and then gave it to Li Qingshan to weigh.

"Tomorrow morning, it will be the same time, and they will definitely come again, and the price will be the same today. We caught these fish, but our old noses are useless. We are not the only ones catching fish. We are just here to sell fish."

"Auntie, your daughter-in-law just gave birth to a baby. Let's bring in a crucian carp. The crucian carp is stewed with tofu and the milky-white soup will be made. It will definitely be a great supplement. There is also this black fish stick, which produces milk. It is also stewed with tofu. It is delicious and nutritious. The milk is also nutritious. My grandson will definitely grow white and fat after eating it."

"My uncle has bad teeth. Hey... fish is not pork, and a three-year-old can chew it. It's perfect."

"Uncle, look, the scale that is high is not low at all."

As Li Qingshan talked, he began to weigh the fish. The fish of more than 500 kilograms were almost sold out in a short time, and there were still two eels left that no one bought.

The main thing is that this thing is expensive, only a cent and a pound, and there are not many people eating here, so they are not very good at eating it. However, this thing is a great tonic for men, and it is also called a man's water.

The eels of this era were much larger than those of later generations.

In later generations, many eels were caught that were as thick as chopsticks, and the larger ones were no more than the thickness of a thumb. But the two that Li Qingshan caught today were as thick as a baby's arm, and weighed about three kilograms, just like a small eel.
